meta.title: deep-bench
meta.winsFormula: projWins = 41 + 2.7 x team BPM; team BPM = 2/3 starter + 1/3 bench (minute-weighted)
meta.benchWinsMetric: wins a bench adds vs a league-average bench, holding a 1/3 minute share fixed
disclosures: 22 players (2026 rookies + season-long injured) have no 2025-26 BPM and are excluded; teams flagged with dataFlag are understated.
11 unsigned free agents carry no 2026-27 salary; bench payroll is committed salary only.
All value is last-season BPM: blind to fit, chemistry, coaching, and player development.
costPerBenchWin is undefined for teams at or below an average bench (can't divide by a non-positive win contribution).
Minutes/lineup optima are linear and therefore extreme; read direction and size of each delta, not the literal figure.
